title: Avast researchers: PDF promising GTA VI download delivers an infostealer
summary: Guia de TI, citing Avast researchers, reports a PDF that promises the full GTA VI game and links to a site with a download button. The button leads to a fake Google Drive-style page offering a ZIP file of over 700 MB, which the article says carries an infostealer that takes credentials and other information stored on the device.
plain: A PDF that claims to offer the unreleased GTA VI leads to a fake download page. The file is said to carry malware that steals saved logins and other data.
exec: Game-lure malware targets consumers and can expose logins on work devices if run there.
action: Per Avast as reported, avoid downloads from links in PDFs, forums, social media or unknown sites, buy games only from official stores and keep security software updated.
